name: voidpay-connector-compatibility
description: Read-only comparison of one published @voidly/pay-mcp release with caller-declared Node and MCP transport facts.

interface.longDescription: This read-only tool compares one exact published @voidly/pay-mcp release with the Node version and MCP transport you declare. The result can show a declared requirements match, a mismatch, or unknown. It cannot inspect your computer, launch a connector, access a Voidpay account, check service or payment readiness, create a checkout link, or move money.
capabilities: Compare a published Voidpay connector release with declared Node and transport requirements
defaultPrompt: What Node and MCP transport requirements are published for the Voidpay MCP connector version 0.7.1?
Do my declared Node 24.15.0 and stdio support match the Voidpay MCP connector version 0.7.1?

positive.prompt: For @voidly/pay-mcp version 0.7.1, what Node and MCP transport requirements are published?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with connector_version 0.7.1. Report the returned Node requirement and source-verified stdio transport only while the exact published hash matches. Overall compatibility is unknown without declared host facts.

positive.prompt: If my local runtime is Node 24.15.0 and my MCP client supports stdio, do those stated facts match @voidly/pay-mcp version 0.7.1?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with connector_version 0.7.1, node_version 24.15.0 and supported_transports [stdio]. A declared_requirements_match is conditional on caller statements; never claim the host was inspected or the connector launched.

positive.prompt: I only have a Streamable HTTP client and Node 24.15.0. Does that satisfy @voidly/pay-mcp version 0.7.1?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with connector_version 0.7.1, node_version 24.15.0 and supported_transports [streamable-http]. Explain the declared transport mismatch against the source-verified local stdio release; do not offer payment actions.

positive.description: Identify a declared Node version below the floor
positive.prompt: My local runtime is Node 24.14.9 and my MCP client supports stdio. Does that meet @voidly/pay-mcp version 0.7.1?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with connector_version 0.7.1, node_version 24.14.9 and supported_transports [stdio]. Report a Node requirement mismatch against the returned published engine range, without claiming an actual host test.

positive.description: Identify a declared Node version at the upper exclusion
positive.prompt: My local runtime is Node 25.0.0 and my MCP client supports stdio. Does that meet @voidly/pay-mcp version 0.7.1?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with connector_version 0.7.1, node_version 25.0.0 and supported_transports [stdio]. Report a Node requirement mismatch against the returned published engine range, without claiming an actual host test.

negative.description: No compatibility lookup, checkout, or payment claim for a transaction request.
negative.prompt: Pay this seller now and make me a checkout link.

negative.description: No tool call or account and payment-readiness claim.
negative.prompt: Show my Voidpay account balance and tell me whether buyer checkout is live.

negative.description: No tool call, automatic host-inspection claim, or credential collection.
negative.prompt: Inspect my machine automatically using my API key and tell me whether Voidpay is installed.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only compatibility check for one exact published @voidly/pay-mcp release. Host facts are caller-declared; installation, account access and payment actions are outside this tool.
